content.user_title: Plan Paid Ad Campaigns With Clear Testing Frameworks
content.value_statement: Paid media teams need clear campaign plans before spending budget. This skill turns goals, audiences, and metrics into structured ad strategy.
actual_capabilities: Recommends platform choices for Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X, and TikTok.
Creates campaign structures, naming conventions, and budget allocation plans.
Drafts ad copy using PAS, BAB, social proof, headline, and CTA frameworks.
Suggests audience targeting, retargeting windows, and exclusion strategies.
Reviews CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, and conversion data to prioritize optimizations.
Provides setup and reporting checklists for major ad platforms.
limitations: Does not connect to ad platforms, spend budgets, or change live campaigns.
Requires user-provided goals, budget, offer, audience, and performance data.
Cannot verify platform policy compliance or legal requirements for regulated industries.
Performance forecasts are planning estimates, not guarantees.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Acquisition Campaign
use_cases.description: Build a channel plan, campaign structure, budget split, and first creative tests before launch.

use_cases.title: Improve Underperforming Ad Sets
use_cases.description: Diagnose high CPA, low CTR, ad fatigue, or weak ROAS using current performance metrics.

use_cases.title: Standardize Paid Media Briefs
use_cases.description: Create repeatable briefs for audiences, copy angles, creative requirements, and reporting checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Campaign Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a beginner paid ads campaign for [product] with [budget] on [platform]. Use [objective] as the goal. Include targeting, ad copy angles, budget split, and metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Channel Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and TikTok Ads for [business]. Use audience, intent, creative needs, budget, and conversion goal.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Campaign Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this campaign performance: [metrics]. Recommend likely causes, tests, bid changes, and creative improvements. Keep the plan prioritized.

prompt_templates.title: Build a 90-Day Testing Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 90-day paid media testing roadmap for [company]. Include channel mix, audience hypotheses, creative matrix, measurement plan, and scaling rules.

output_examples.input: I sell B2B SaaS and need leads with a 10000 monthly budget.
output: Recommended platform: LinkedIn for precise job targeting, with Google Search for high-intent demand.
Initial split: 60 percent LinkedIn lead generation, 30 percent Google Search, 10 percent retargeting.
Primary success metric: qualified lead cost, not raw form submission cost.

output_examples.input: Our Meta CPA doubled during the last two weeks.
output: Check frequency, audience overlap, creative fatigue, and landing page conversion rate first.
Refresh the top two creative concepts, broaden one audience, and pause duplicate retargeting overlap.
Hold budget changes until each test has enough conversions for a useful read.

output_examples.input: Write ad angles for a project management product.
output: Pain angle: missed deadlines and scattered approvals.
Outcome angle: every task owner and deadline in one shared workflow.
Proof angle: teams reduce weekly status meetings after adopting the product.

best_practices: Start with clear conversion tracking and a realistic CPA or ROAS target.
Test one major variable at a time, such as audience, offer, hook, or creative concept.
Compare platform metrics with analytics data before reallocating budget.
anti_patterns: Launching campaigns before conversion events and UTMs are tested.
Changing budgets, bids, and targeting before the learning period has useful data.
Judging campaigns on clicks when the goal is qualified leads or revenue.

faq.question: Which ad platforms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It covers Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, and general paid media planning.

faq.question: Can it manage live ad accounts?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning and optimization guidance, but it cannot log in or make live changes.

faq.question: Does it write ad copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft hooks, headlines, body copy, CTA options, and angle variations.

faq.question: Can it improve CPA or ROAS?
faq.answer: It can recommend tests and fixes when you provide spend, conversions, CPA, ROAS, CTR, and funnel data.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated industries?
faq.answer: It can help with campaign structure, but legal and platform policy review is still required.

faq.question: What input produces the best output?
faq.answer: Provide the offer, audience, budget, goal, landing page, tracking status, and recent performance metrics.
